critical_code_review_comments: server.py:592-607 /api/search uses re.escape on q — safe against ReDoS. Good.
server.py:640-648 DELETE /api/comments/{id} correctly checks ownership OR admin — good authorization pattern.
server.py:654-675 POST /api/completions is idempotent by design (find_one first) — clean pattern; also snapshots title/category into completions doc so certificates survive later content edits.
server.py:727-756 register() gracefully handles missing/invalid referral_code (silent ignore) and always generates a unique referral_code with a while-loop guard against collisions.
server.py:262-266 _gen_referral_code strips diacritics and uses uppercased first-6-chars-of-name + 4 random hex digits — reasonable; admin has an explicit override 'MAESTRO-2026'.
AudioPlayer.tsx uses expo-audio (correct, non-deprecated) — useAudioPlayer + useAudioPlayerStatus hooks; no expo-av. ✓
